label: Density equals the chromatic number
subgoals: Represent each net by its closed column interval
Find the column covered by the most intervals
Read that count as the minimum number of tracks

label: The left-edge algorithm
subgoals: Sort intervals by their left ends
Place each on the lowest track whose last interval ends before it starts
Open a new track only when none fits

label: Where the model breaks
subgoals: Add vertical constraints from pins at the same column
Recognize that vertical constraints make the problem NP-hard
Reuse the sweep to assign registers to value lifetimes
